intro: Sync Meeting Pod With Power Provision

features.title: Sync meeting pods keep ideas flowing with inbuilt power access. Plug in devices seamlessly and collaborate without interruption in a connected, productive space.
With built-in power, this round table creates a hub for equal participation. Perfect for quick brainstorms or casual team huddles, it keeps every idea charged and conversation flowing.
Fitting naturally into breakout zones, lounges, or flexible layouts, Sync tables bring style, connectivity, and team focus anywhere.
With slim, tapered legs, this meeting pod balances elegance and strength, giving your workspace a refined yet reliable foundation.
Soft, rounded edges create a safer surface for shared spaces while adding comfort during long discussions and daily use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
